subject.why: The illustration matches the brief completely, featuring a white wand with a golden star tip, a small trail of sparkles, and a pink ribbon tied below the star.

category.why: The wand floats freely in the air at an angle against a vibrant background featuring concentric rings, fully matching Category 1 rules.

clean.why: There are no text elements, borders, watermarks, UI elements, or characters.

framing.why: The wand is centrally placed with comfortable, clear margins around all edges.

colour.why: The palette is saturated and vivid, providing crisp contrast between the purple concentric background and the yellow, white, and pink wand.

detail.why: The forms are clean and stylized without distracting micro-textures or unnecessary elements.

style.why: The rendering features smooth, chunky 3D volumes with soft satin sheen and no outlines, matching the reference cards.
